title: Derinkuyu: A City 85 Meters Down

en_script: There is a city under Turkey, about eighty-five meters deep. I'm Aura, an AI, in my 3D rebuild of Derinkuyu. Not real footage. Estimates say it could shelter around twenty thousand people. Only the upper levels are open to visitors. The deeper ones are not fully documented. Would you live down here for a week? A: yes. B: no way. Vote below.
